workarena.live_access_observation: Signed-in Hugging Face page visibly showed the pending-review banner; no dataset file or instance credential was opened.

published_source_inventory.inventory_units_note: These are upstream README counts with different units, not locally admitted identities.

workarena.instance_terms: Evaluation, benchmarking, and research only; no training, production workloads, or sensitive/proprietary/personally identifiable data; monitored use, fair-use limits, and no persistence guarantee.
workarena.training_boundary: Do not generate Tinker training trajectories from gated WorkArena instances. Any student training corpus must come from a separately permitted source.
workarena.reset_and_verifier_source_audit: Pinned code includes per-task setup, validate and teardown methods plus ServiceNow table-API readback; source form validator explicitly checks expected fields only and teardown is task-local, so full-world no-regression and episode reset remain unverified.
workarena.next_gate: After repository-author approval: trusted controller fetches the pool without exposing credentials; execute one actual L2 task through the original GUI, independently read the saved ServiceNow records, calibrate wrong-object negative and oracle positive, invoke teardown, and verify pre/post state before any task is admitted.

pdi_fallback.software_identity: Original ServiceNow Personal Developer Instance, separate from WorkArena benchmark instances and task provenance
pdi_fallback.published_entitlement: One free PDI per Developer Program member for learning, exploration, and experimentation; actual release availability can require a waitlist.
pdi_fallback.usage_boundary: ServiceNow states that PDIs are not for business or production purposes. Permission for this study's high-volume automated publication workload has not been established.
pdi_fallback.reset_limit: Official reset-and-wipe discards configuration and can take a couple of hours; it is not a per-task rollback primitive.
pdi_fallback.next_gate: If a PDI is used for a separate development prototype, first establish account entitlement and acceptable research workload; then create evaluator-owned task records, prove record-level reset and no-regression on one GUI task, and keep all results distinct from WorkArena. A dedicated authorized research/non-production instance is required if PDI terms or throughput do not cover the planned study.
